speaker: Doctor
text: The baby has had difficulty passing stool, decreased feeding, and increasing abdominal distension without vomiting or fever. This constellation of symptoms is highly suggestive of intestinal obstruction. REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_Ultrasound. REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_X-Ray.
